title: Surface a promote proposal nobody has applied yet
action: Make an unapplied promote proposal visible as open work (per D3). bee close writes docs/history/<slug>/promote-proposals.md and today nothing ever reads it: two such files exist, zero were applied, and docs/knowledge/work/ still holds the one delivery it held before. Scan docs/history/*/promote-proposals.md, treat a proposal as APPLIED once that feature has a recorded compounding run at or after the proposal file's modification time, and surface every unapplied one in bee orient and in the session preamble as a named line carrying the feature and the proposal's counts, with the path to the file. Follow the shape the existing scribing-debt and capture-queue lines already use in those two surfaces rather than inventing a new one — read them first and match their voice and their placement. This is a REPORT, never a refusal: nothing about it blocks a command, changes an exit code, or gates a phase. Find the recorded compounding run through the existing state helpers rather than re-parsing any store by hand.

truths: bee orient names each feature holding an unapplied promote proposal, with its counts and file path
The session preamble carries the same line
A proposal whose feature has a compounding run recorded at or after the file's mtime is treated as applied and is not surfaced
No command's exit code or refusal behaviour changes because of this line

artifacts.substantive: an unapplied-proposal line matching the scribing-debt line's shape

key_links: orient and the preamble read the same proposal scan
prohibitions: Nothing about this surfacing refuses, blocks, or changes an exit code
The rendered preamble stays within PREAMBLE_BUDGET_BYTES
No file under docs/knowledge/ is created, moved, or deleted

trace.outcome: Surfaced unapplied docs/history/<feature>/promote-proposals.md as a report-only line in bee orient (work.blockers) and the session preamble; applied-status reuses the existing best-scribing-stamp helper. Deviation: also touched hooks/session_preamble/budget.rs (the actual build_session_preamble call site, not listed in cell files) and verbs/status_full/tests.rs (new coverage) since the cell's file list predates the module split.
